title: testOS Benchmark Plan
description: Versioned (schema_version=1) benchmark plan generated by rush-autopilot. The plan records the source commit, source version, generation timestamp, and dry_run state. The strict evidence validator cross-checks these fields against the run-intent: a plan whose internal source_commit or run_id disagrees with the intent is rejected even if its SHA-256 matches the bundled bytes. Schema version is frozen at 1.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the plan was generated.

source_version.description: Rush Linux project version. Must match the run-intent's source_version.

source_commit.description: 40-character git commit SHA. Must match the run-intent's source_commit.

dry_run.description: Whether this is a dry-run plan. Must match the run-intent's dry_run.

run_id.description: Optional run identifier. If present, must match the run-intent's run_id.
